audit.whatIsWrong: My packet reports 51.75% over 143 games; MC_WR_TABLES.sejuani.mordekaiser is 47.11.
audit.why: The table is the Emerald+ figure the site actually ships, and 47.11 is the number the HARD label and the Mordekaiser-heavy chart were built around. The packet figure would invert the whole matchup.
HARD at 7/10 with Mordekaiser taking six of seven stages matches 47.11%. No change made.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike and whys[5] both attributed his power to a Rylai's Crystal Scepter purchase.
audit.why: The kit files carry no item data, so the item claim is unverifiable — but there is a better, checkable reason his loop is relentless: every Mordekaiser ability costs zero mana (Q, W, E and R all list 'No Cost'), so the E-Q-W cycle is gated purely by cooldowns, never by resource. Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s and Obliterate falls from 8s to 4s.
audit.corrected: Both lines now cite the free-cast loop and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani's resistances were called 'passive Permafrost resistances' in wants.foe[2] and whys[6], and Indestructible was described only as 'his W heal and shield sustain'.
audit.why: Sejuani's resistances come from Fury of the North / Frost Armor, not from Permafrost, which is only the stun. Indestructible 'stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal' — the shield-to-heal conversion is what actually outlasts a Frost Armor window, and it is on 12/11/10/9/8s.
audit.corrected: Correct passive name used, and Indestructible now named with its mechanic and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers, only 'track it always'.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — by a wide margin the longest cooldown either champion holds, and the single most punishable thing in the matchup. Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8s at 700 range is the lane-level clock.
audit.corrected: Both stated, with the two-safe-minutes conclusion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' without naming what heals.
audit.why: The heal is Indestructible consuming its own shield. Naming it tells the player what they are actually cutting.

edits.before: Mordekaiser's Rylai's Crystal Scepter spike makes his E pull into Q isolated-bonus into W shield loop lethal — respect the all-in window here.
edits.after: His whole kit costs zero mana, so the E pull (16s at rank 1) into isolated Obliterate into Indestructible loop waits only on cooldowns.

edits.before: Force extended trades where his W heal and shield sustain outlast your passive Permafrost resistances
edits.after: Force long trades where Indestructible's shield-into-heal outlasts Fury of the North's Frost Armor

edits.before: His W heal and Q isolated-bonus out-sustain your damage at levels 4-5 — save Permafrost stacks for gank setups, not solo trades.
edits.after: Indestructible (12s at rank 1) and the isolated Obliterate bonus out-sustain you at 4-5 — save Frost stacks for gank setups.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter makes his E-Q-W loop lethal in extended fights — his first item spike is real, respect it even when your tank item lands.
edits.after: Zero mana costs mean his E-Q-W loop never stops in a long fight, and Indestructible cashes its shield as a heal — the item spike is real.

edits.before: At full tank builds your passive Permafrost resistances outlive his 1v1 Realm of Death window, and your CC uptime in teamfights exceeds anything his R isolation can answer.
edits.after: At full tank Fury of the North's resistances outlive his 1v1 Realm of Death window (140s at rank 1), and your teamfight CC beats anything his R isolation answers.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — The isolated 1v1 is his whole kill threat — track it always. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane, so a spent R buys you two safe minutes. - Death's Grasp (E): 16/14/12/10/8s pull at 700 range. - Obliterate (Q): 8s down to 4s, and free. - Your Q is for when it goes wrong.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser’s Realm of Death: The isolated 1v1 is his whole kill threat — track it always. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Every ability he casts is free — there is no mana bar to drain. Your only clock is Death's Grasp, 16s at rank 1: step up on its downtime.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pots. First: Sunfire Aegis into Plated Steelcaps or Mercs; then Thornmail or Kaenic Rookern by damage type. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pots. First: Sunfire Aegis into Steelcaps or Mercs; then Thornmail or Kaenic Rookern. Anti-heal early — Indestructible cashes its shield as a heal.

edits.before: The isolated 1v1 is his whole kill threat — track it always. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: The isolated 1v1 is his whole kill threat, and Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 — a spent ult is free lane.

notes: Left untouched because it cannot be verified from the kits: content.mid claims 'his E pull can cancel your Q escape'. Death's Grasp is a pull and Arctic Assault is a charge, but whether a displacement interrupts an in-progress charge is not in Riot's text, so I did not restate or remove it. Same for 'R-flash initiate' in content.mid — Flash-buffering behaviour is explicitly outside what these files can answer. Also note the packet/table win-rate disagreement recorded under point 1; the same disagreement appears on malphite and nasus.
